about.title: About:
about.paragraph1: Hi! I'm Alberto Ayza, a cybersecurity student and junior ethical hacking researcher from Argentina. I focus on web hacking: I practice with bug bounty programs and VDPs, PortSwigger Web Security Academy labs, OWASP Juice Shop and CTFs, and I use Caido as my intercepting proxy.
about.paragraph2: Before moving into security I worked as a full-stack web developer (JavaScript, React, Node.js, Express and MongoDB). That background helps me understand how web applications are built, and therefore how they break. I hold a <1>Higher Technician degree in Applied Computing</1> (2022) from <3>INSPT</3> - <5>UTN</5>, in Buenos Aires.
about.paragraph3: I'm also a freelancer and entrepreneur, and I'm currently studying Web3. If you want to talk about web development, security or a project, reach out through the Contact section.
